title: PR #100: fix: remove wall-clock sources from determinism tests
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

## Scope

Remove the 24 REQ-ENG-002 wall-clock findings from the ATC blockchain test suite.

### Root cause

All 24 findings were test-only temporary-path generation using `SystemTime::now()`. They were not consensus/runtime clock reads.

### Fix

Both affected test modules now use a deterministic test-only `test_temp_path(name)` helper. Test names provide stable unique path identifiers; no allowlist entry is added.

Changed files:
- `components/a-townchain/modules/atc-blockchain/kernel/src/storage.rs`
- `components/a-townchain/modules/atc-blockchain/kernel/src/blockchain.rs`

### Evidence intent

- 24/24 historical REQ-ENG-002 findings targeted.
- `SystemTime::now()` count: 0 in both affected files.
- No production consensus/block-processing logic changed.
- One commit, one scope.
- Base: `916856ac28fa463afd5e63f4e0e744fb279d35c3`
- Head: `61af6cba6ff703a0dfa1049619c76dba5125687a`

The Determinism Gate must establish the final result through its own Exact-SHA execution evidence; no green status is treated as VERIFIED by itself.
